profile.name: standard
profile.description: Conventional signal practice, and what the product runs: a 15 s minimum green, long enough for a pedestrian phase, and a 30 s maximum so nobody waits through a whole cycle.

metric: mean total delay per requested vehicle
rule: Lowest validation mean of the metric among single runs and averaged ensembles whose every run obeyed the timing profile. Decided before the test split was measured.
